title_en: Halley's Comet Returns Only Once in a Lifetime #Shorts
desc_en:
Halley's Comet comes back about every 76 years. It was last seen in 1986 and returns in July 2061. That is about the length of one human life, so most people see it only once.

Sources: NASA Science; Britannica.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
